page_title: OSA 2-0 GRA | Osasuna v Granada CF 20/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Raul (Osasuna) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
90+6' Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+6' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) is able to continue to play.
90+4' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+1' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Osasuna players look gutted.
90' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Osasuna players aren’t happy.
88' Raul (Osasuna) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
87' Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gerard Gumbau.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) will replace Jesus Areso.
85' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kike Barja (Osasuna) replacing Ruben Pena.
85' The attendance is 19739.
84' The referee shows the yellow card to Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
83' The substitution is prepared. Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gonzalo Villar.
83' Substitution. Jose Callejon (Granada CF) on for Ricard Sanchez.
80' Substitution. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) in, Aimar Oroz out.
80' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Raul (Osasuna) replaces Ante Budimir.
79' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) receives a yellow card!
77' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer had no choice but to send Lucas Boye (Granada CF) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

77' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Lucas Boye (Granada CF), but referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
76' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Lucas Boye (Granada CF).
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Granada CF.
68' Substitution. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) has come on for Jon Moncayola.
68' A cross from Chimy Avila (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
65' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Ruben Pena (Osasuna), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
63' Paco Lopez prepares a substitution. Alvaro Fernandez is replaced by Antonio Puertas (Granada CF).
63' It is time for a substitution. Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is on for Oscar Melendo.
59' 2 - 0 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Andre Ferreira to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
59' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
58' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Andre Ferreira (Granada CF) for his blatant foul.
58' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
58' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
57' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
55' Granada CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
54' It must be a yellow card. It is. Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
52' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes.
48' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
48' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Granada CF quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

47' Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. Granada CF win a corner kick.
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) picks up a caution.
42' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
42' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
42' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul. Granada CF are given a penalty!
41' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.

38' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Boye (Granada CF), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. Corner kick. Granada CF will have an opportunity.
37' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
36' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Sergio Herrera comes off his line to intercept.
28' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Chimy Avila (Osasuna) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
27' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
21' A cross into the box from Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is cleared. The ball has crossed the sideline. Osasuna are taking a throw-in.
15' The corner is swung in but Granada CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
15' The resulting set piece from Granada CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
14' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes wild in celebration.
13' The Osasuna players halt their celebrations as referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Ante Budimir (Osasuna) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
11' A lofted cross from Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
6' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
5' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Granada CF will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
